text: Fine goods from every port in the Reach! Cargo bought and sold.
{npc}, merchant. My prices move with the market, captain, and the market moves with you.
Buying or selling? Both, I hope.
Keep your voice down. There are marines about, and your face is on the posters.
I'll serve you, but quickly. Bounty hunters drink in here.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.
Every port grows something and lacks something. Buy cheap where it grows, sell dear where it's short.
Buy a lot and the price climbs. Sell a lot and it falls. Wait, and it drifts back. Your ship's hold counts as your pocket here.
Look at the 'wanted' marks on my price list. Those pay best here.
Whatever's marked 'wanted'. And whatever's in a shortage, if you heard the news.
Rum from Saltmarrow to Port Meridian. Silk from Kingsport to Saltmarrow. Salt fish anywhere they dig or pray.
Sugar from the bayou to Kingsport. Ironware from Goldwater to the navy purser at Crownwatch.
